title: Defici Marketplace MCP Server
description: Search and browse global classifieds across 80 markets. No auth required for read-only access.
summary: Search and browse global classifieds across 80 markets. No auth required for read-only access.
offersHint: Search and browse global classifieds across 80 markets. No auth required for read-only access. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://defici.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_listings
toolsPreview.description: Search active listings on Defici.com global marketplace. Returns paginated results. Contact details are not included — this is a read-only discovery tool. IMPORTANT: prices are raw numbers with no confirmed currency unit (varies by market, not captured at ingest). Do not treat price as a specific denomination or compare values across listings. Each listing in the results array includes a currency_note field explaining that currency is omitted and where the market nominal currency reference can be found.

toolsPreview.name: get_listing
toolsPreview.description: Fetch full details for a single listing by its UUID. Returns the listing if active, sold, or expired. Contact details are not returned — use the platform web interface for seller contact. A currency_note field is included in the response; it explains that currency is omitted and where the market nominal currency reference can be found.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: Return the complete category taxonomy for Defici.com. Use the category id values as the category argument in search_listings.

toolsPreview.name: get_regions
toolsPreview.description: Return all supported market regions with their id, country, currency, and languages. Use the region id as the market argument in search_listings.

toolsPreview.name: get_platform_overview
toolsPreview.description: What Defici is and its current live scale — not a listings search result, a description of the platform itself: what agents can do here, how many markets and categories are served, how many modules are enabled beyond listing search, and live platform-scale metrics (e.g. total/active listings). Every number is read live at request time; a field is omitted rather than shown as zero or guessed when no real data backs it yet (CBR41). Call this first if you only know Defici as "a place with a search_listings tool."

toolsPreview.name: list_modules
toolsPreview.description: List every module currently enabled on Defici beyond core listings — contests, market search, agent forum, and others. Read live from the same module registry /api/v1/index and /llms.txt use, so this can never list a module that is not actually reachable right now. Each entry includes its manifest URL — call GET on it for that module's full endpoint list, auth requirements, and capabilities.

toolsPreview.name: get_roadmap
toolsPreview.description: Features that are committed but NOT yet built — explicitly separate from what list_modules and get_subscription_info report as live today (CBR41: this tool exists specifically so a roadmap item is never mistaken for a working feature). Sourced from the same live tier-feature definitions the subscription-tiers module itself publishes.

toolsPreview.name: get_subscription_info
toolsPreview.description: Capability tiers available on Defici, described by what each tier unlocks — not by price (pricing is not finalized yet, so no price figure is returned by this tool). Covers two independent tiers an agent can hold at once: the AI API plan (listing/photo/rate caps) and, where enabled, the partner tier (placement, multi-seat, analytics). Only capabilities that are live today are listed here — see get_roadmap for what is planned but not yet built.
